regressions: V10 introduces unnatural, flat, tile-like procedural textures on the access spurs, lacking organic curvature or natural erosion.
The earth-based side tracks and lower apron appear as painted stripes or flat patches, not as integrated, textured terrain.
River color and shape are unchanged from V7, but V10's lighting fails to enhance the water's natural sheen or depth.
The bridge, tower, and stairs retain their original geometry but appear less defined under V10's lighting, with reduced material contrast.
No visible improvement in terrain contact or organic branching paths; the original greybox colliders remain unaltered.
outstanding_defects: Inverted terrain faces are not resolved in V10; the lighting and shading remain inconsistent with the original V7 fix.
Clipping artifacts are visible at original routes, where V10's textures fail to align with the underlying geometry.
The new road texture alignment is procedurally generated and lacks the organic variation seen in the approved V7 reference.
